verdict: Paid campaigns are paused; organic is holding while contract work closes.
narrative: No paid spend ran in the last 28 days — both Meta and Google campaigns are fully off, so zero paid leads were generated this period. Organic activity continued to carry the load: your Google Business Profile drove 149 actions over the 28-day window, including 53 calls, and your website received 1,629 sessions. The contract extension needed to restart paid campaigns was due August 31 and is still unsigned; that single item is the gate to turning the paid engine back on. Once the agreement is in place, paid activation and the supporting CRM automations are queued to follow in September.

highlights.phrase: Google Business Profile actions this period (53 calls, 96 website clicks)
website sessions driven in the last 28 days
paid ad spend this period — campaigns are currently paused

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement shows zero activity for the past 8 days, which appears to be a data feed interruption rather than a true drop in visibility.
watch_item.fix: The data connection is being investigated this week; the 28-day call and click totals confirm real activity continued through the period.
